title: 要件の検討
when: Review, define or organize the requirements of a new feature or change that someone asks the project manager to think through, and produce a first draft (not a yes/no decision)

steps.title: 目的・解決したい課題・対象ユーザーを依頼元に確認
steps.desc: Ask the requester what problem this solves, for whom, and how success will be judged

steps.title: 現状の機能と制約（依存・期限・予算）を整理
steps.desc: List what exists today and the constraints: dependencies, deadline, budget, compliance
steps.check: Does the request mention a deadline, a customer, a proposal or another team that constrains the work?

steps.title: 要件の叩き台（必須・あると良い・対象外）を作成
steps.desc: Write a first draft that separates must-have, nice-to-have and out-of-scope

steps.title: 受け入れ条件と非機能要件（性能・セキュリティ・運用）を追記
steps.desc: Add acceptance criteria and non-functional requirements to the draft

steps.title: 依頼元・開発・QA で要件をレビュー
steps.desc: Walk through the draft with the requester, the developers and QA
steps.check: Will more than one team or role have to agree on this?

steps.title: 合意した要件をチケットに登録し、見積りを依頼
steps.desc: Register the agreed requirements as work items and ask the team for an estimate
